cmd: ls /app /app/vendor 2>&1; echo ---; which gcc make gcov 2>&1; echo ---; gcc --version | head -1
cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -3; which apt-get yum dnf apk 2>&1; echo ---; ls /usr/bin | grep -iE '^(gcc|cc|make|g\+\+)' | head
apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "=== update done ==="
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq gcc make 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "=== install done ==="
WAIT 20
gcc --version | head -1; make --version | head -1; ls -la /app/vendor/; cat /app/vendor/sqlite-fossil-release.tar.gz.sha256; sha256sum /app/vendor/sqlite-fossil-release.tar.gz
tar -tzf /app/vendor/sqlite-fossil-release.tar.gz | head -20; echo ---; tar -tzf /app/vendor/sqlite-fossil-release.tar.gz | wc -l
tar -tzf /app/vendor/sqlite-fossil-release.tar.gz | grep -E '^(sqlite/[^/]+)$' | sort
cd /app && tar -xzf /app/vendor/sqlite-fossil-release.tar.gz && ls -la /app/sqlite/ | head; echo "=== extracted ==="
cd /app/sqlite && cat VERSION && ./configure --help 2>&1 | head -40
cd /app/sqlite && ./configure CFLAGS="-fprofile-arcs -ftest-coverage -O0 -g" 2>&1 | tail -30
cd /app/sqlite && grep -E '^(CFLAGS|CXXFLAGS|CC) *[:?]?=' Makefile | head; echo ---; grep -n 'profile-arcs' Makefile | head
cd /app/sqlite && make -j$(nproc) 2>&1 | tail -25
WAIT 30
cd /app/sqlite && ls -la sqlite3 sqlite3.o libsqlite3.so libsqlite3.a 2>&1; echo "=== version ==="; ./sqlite3 --version 2>&1
cd /app/sqlite && echo "=== gcov symbols in binary ==="; nm sqlite3 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'gcov' | head; echo "=== count ==="; nm sqlite3 2>/dev/null | grep -icE 'gcov'
echo "PATH=$PATH"; echo "---"; which sqlite3 2>&1; echo "---"; ls -la /usr/local/bin/ 2>&1 | head
ln -sf /app/sqlite/sqlite3 /usr/local/bin/sqlite3 && ls -la /usr/local/bin/sqlite3 && echo "--- which ---" && which sqlite3 && echo "--- version via PATH ---" && sqlite3 --version
cd /app/sqlite && rm -f *.gcda && sqlite3 :memory: "CREATE TABLE t(x); INSERT INTO t VALUES (1),(2),(3); SELECT SUM(x) FROM t;" && echo "=== run done, checking gcda ===" && ls -la *.gcda 2>&1 | head
cd /app/sqlite && which gcov && echo "=== gcno files ===" && ls -la *.gcno 2>&1 && echo "=== run gcov on sqlite3 ===" && gcov sqlite3-sqlite3.gcda 2>&1 | head -15
cd /tmp && rm -f /app/sqlite/*.gcda && sqlite3 :memory: "SELECT 1+1;" && echo "=== gcda in /app/sqlite after run from /tmp ===" && ls -la /app/sqlite/*.gcda 2>&1

echo "=== 1. Source + build in /app/sqlite ==="; ls -d /app/sqlite && ls /app/sqlite/sqlite3 /app/sqlite/libsqlite3.so /app/sqlite/libsqlite3.a
echo "=== 2. Built with gcov flags (Makefile) ==="; grep -E '^CFLAGS *=' /app/sqlite/Makefile
echo "=== 3. On PATH ==="; command -v sqlite3; readlink -f "$(command -v sqlite3)"
echo "=== 4. gcov-instrumented (symbol count) ==="; nm "$(command -v sqlite3)" 2>/dev/null | grep -c gcov
echo "=== 5. Works (real DB op) ==="; rm -f /tmp/t.db; sqlite3 /tmp/t.db "CREATE TABLE a(b); INSERT INTO a VALUES(41),(1); SELECT b+1 FROM a ORDER BY b;"
echo "=== 6. gcov produces report ==="; cd /app/sqlite && gcov -n sqlite3-sqlite3.gcda 2>&1 | grep -E 'Lines executed'

rm -f /tmp/t.db
echo "=== FINAL STATE ==="
echo "Binary on PATH: $(command -v sqlite3) -> $(readlink -f "$(command -v sqlite3)")"
echo "Version: $(sqlite3 --version)"
echo "gcov symbols: $(nm "$(command -v sqlite3)" 2>/dev/null | grep -c gcov)"
echo "gcda files present: $(ls /app/sqlite/*.gcda 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo "gcov tool: $(command -v gcov)"
echo "=== exit code check ==="
sqlite3 :memory: "SELECT 'ok';" && echo "sqlite3 runs OK (exit $?)"
